question: Which materials are identified as suitable for the vessels in this teaching?
premises: Several types of vessels are listed by material.
The materials include clay, tortoise-derived, bell-metal, and copper-metal.
The goddess is addressed in this enumeration.
inference: Vessels may be made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, or copper-metal.
uncertainties: The exact meaning of kūrmajaṃ as a vessel material is contextually ambiguous.
plain_english: O Goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell-metal, or made of copper.
